stories.h: Emdoor rugged laptops gain improved Linux support via new platform driver
stories.s: Emdoor announced a new platform driver that enhances Linux compatibility for its rugged laptops and tablets used in various industries.

stories.h: Thermal Grizzly details 24‑month WireView Pro II GPU warranty conditions
stories.s: The warranty covers eligible 12VHPWR or 12V‑2x6 connector damage for 24 months from purchase, is non‑transferable, requires monitoring to stay enabled, and excludes general GPU failures or PSU damage.

stories.h: Intel's desktop CPU shipment share rises to 70.1% in Q3 2026
stories.s: Mercury Research reports Intel gained 5.1 percentage points while AMD fell to 29.9%, amid a 13% year‑over‑year decline in desktop CPU volumes.

stories.h: Intel Core Ultra 7 260K limited‑availability CPU unveiled with 20 cores and 5.4 GHz boost
stories.s: Intel says the 260K will only be sold inside two Newegg ABS gaming desktops priced at $1,699.99 and $1,999.99 and will not be offered as a boxed retail part.

stories.h: ASUS releases white ROG Strix B850-I Mini-ITX motherboard with upgraded features
stories.s: The new white version adds physical upgrades, retains dual PCIe Gen 5 M.2 ports, DDR5‑8200 support and Wi‑Fi 7, but carries a higher price tag than the original model.

stories.h: Microsoft adds toggle and query flag to disable AI answers in Bing
stories.s: The Bing AI Search Choice extension for Chrome and Edge lets users turn off AI-generated answers globally, while adding "-ai" to a query disables AI for a single search, per a Microsoft blog post.

stories.h: Malaysia and Singapore probe Nvidia AI chip shipments amid CEO resignation
stories.s: Authorities investigate possible re‑export of Nvidia accelerators by Megaspeed subsidiary and charge a Chinese exec over 917 servers, while no evidence yet of hardware reaching China.

stories.h: AMD ports 50 Hugging Face LLMs to client GPUs in three days using HRX Loom
stories.s: The team used HRX Loom v0.1 and Ryzen AI Max "Strix Halo" hardware to achieve the rapid conversion, demonstrating the workflow's efficiency.

stories.h: ESGAMING launches ZERO MAX gaming PC case with 8° tilted GPU airflow
stories.s: The new case supports GPUs up to 415 mm, up to ten 120 mm fans, a 360 mm top radiator, and features 270° panoramic tempered glass, announced by founder Jack Meng.

stories.h: Lexar 640 GB DIAMOND CFexpress 4.0 Type A kartını təqdim etdi – oxuma sürəti 1800 MB/s-yə, yazma sürəti isə 1650 MB/s-ə qədərdir
stories.s: 799,99 dollar qiymətində təqdim olunan yeni kart VPG800/VPG400 ikili sertifikatlaşdırmasına malikdir, PCIe Gen 4 texnologiyasından istifadə edir, TLC kartlara nisbətən 30 dəfə daha uzun ömür təmin edir və IP68 qorunması ilə məhdud ömür boyu zəmanət daxildir.
stories.he: Lexar launches 640 GB DIAMOND CFexpress 4.0 Type A card with up to 1800 MB/s read and 1650 MB/s write speeds

stories.h: Corsair joins Ansys Technology Partner Program to offer Pro workstations for engineering simulations
stories.s: Corsair Pro FlexPrime R80T provides over 400 TFLOPS single-precision and FlexGrid MG4E2 nearly 500 TFLOPS double-precision, targeting AI, simulation and visualization workloads, with configurations tailored to Ansys applications.

stories.h: Linux 7.5 merge window will include new Glanda GPU driver
stories.s: The drm-misc-next pull request adds the GlandaGPU driver to the upcoming Linux 7.5 merge window slated for late December.

stories.h: Walmart cuts $730 off CyberPower PC with Intel Core Ultra 9 285 and RTX 5070 Ti
stories.s: The desktop now costs $2,479.99 and includes a 24‑core Intel CPU, 16 GB RTX 5070 Ti GPU, 32 GB DDR5 RAM and a 2 TB SSD.

stories.h: Intel posts initial GCC compiler patches for upcoming Coral Rapids and Razor Lake CPUs
stories.s: The patches add new ISA features and enable support in the Linux kernel, aiming to ensure compiler and OS readiness before the processors ship.

stories.h: Ocypus Omega L36 Ultra Engineer Limited Edition AIO cooler reviewed, 200 units released
stories.s: The 360mm AIO features a 2.8‑inch circular IPS display, motorised VRM fan and can lower VRM temps by about 10 °C, with pricing disclosed in the video.

stories.h: Colorful launches iGame X870E Senna V14 AM5 motherboard in China for ¥2,399
stories.s: The board supports Ryzen 7000‑9000 CPUs, offers five M.2 slots (four PCIe 5.0 x4, one PCIe 4.0 x4), USB4, 5 GbE and Wi‑Fi 7, and advertises DDR5 overclocking beyond 8400 MT/s.

stories.h: AMD releases Adrenalin 26.11.1 driver fixing Radeon SSD write bug
stories.s: The optional driver addresses excessive idle writes of 0.3 MB/s to 5 MB/s on RX 7000 series and newer GPUs, a problem previously mitigated by disabling External Events Utility or Resizable BAR.

stories.h: PCWorld lists best monitors of 2026 across categories
stories.s: The guide ranks Dell Ultrasharp U2724DE as overall best, Acer Vero B247Y G as top budget, and Pixio PX248 Wave as best budget gaming monitor, detailing specs and pros/cons.

stories.h: AMD EPYC 9996 256‑core processor shows strong SMT performance gains
stories.s: Benchmarks by Phoronix indicate that Simultaneous Multithreading improves both performance and power efficiency on the new Zen 6 EPYC 9996 and 96‑core EPYC 9686F CPUs.

stories.h: Penguin Solutions launches SMART CXL-8F2W-D4 DDR4 CXL memory add‑in card
stories.s: The card supports up to eight DDR4 RDIMMs on CXL 2.0 platforms, using a Marvell StructeraX controller to help AI data centers reduce memory costs by repurposing existing DDR4 modules.

stories.h: Silicon Motion unveils PCIe Gen5/Gen6 enterprise SSD controllers SM8366, SM8466 and SM8388 at SC26
stories.s: The company detailed specs such as up to 28 GB/s sequential throughput for SM8466 and 256 TB capacity for SM8366, targeting AI factories and hyperscale data centers, and will demo them at Booth #6816 in Chicago.

stories.h: Khronos Group forms group to study high‑level remote offloading API
stories.s: The consortium behind OpenGL, OpenCL and Vulkan announced an exploratory team to evaluate a new API for remote compute offloading, aiming to simplify distributed workloads.

stories.h: Gigabyte's AORUS C510 Glass Infinity chassis wins 2027 CES Innovation Award
stories.s: The award recognizes its built‑in 16‑inch high‑refresh display, flexible placement options and modular cooling, announced by Gigabyte on 12 Nov 2026.

stories.h: UCIe Consortium releases UCIe 4.0 specification for system-level chiplet integration
stories.s: The new spec adds standardized memory links, up to 93.75% data efficiency, 2.5 TB/s/mm bandwidth density, and security features like Trusted Reporting of Chiplet State, aiming at broader use including automotive.

stories.h: NVIDIA releases GeForce 621.24 WHQL driver adding DLSS 5 support for Where Winds Meet
stories.s: The driver, built from branch r621_20-2, also fixes bugs in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 and video playback on RTX 50 Series GPUs, following the 621.14 release on November 4, 2026.

stories.h: Corsair launches HX1000i Shift Crystal 1000W Platinum PSU with transparent chassis
stories.s: The unit, shown at Computex 2026 and released on November 12, features side‑mounted connectors, iCUE LINK integration, PinProtect+ per‑pin protection and a 10‑year warranty, but has a large 200 mm chassis and can be noisy when hot.

stories.h: Nvidia co‑founder Jensen Huang steps down as CEO, CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO
stories.s: The board announced Huang's departure after 33 years and appointed Kress while searching for a permanent successor; shares fell sharply and the company will report results on Nov 17.

stories.h: Corsair HX1000i Shift Crystal 1000W PSU reviewed at £249.99 UK price
stories.s: The review highlights its transparent chassis, PinProtect+ per‑pin OCP, iCUE LINK hub and ten‑year warranty, noting efficiency up to 91% and customizable RGB fan.

stories.h: NVIDIA reports ForgePtr and NvRoot driver vulnerabilities affecting Linux GPUs
stories.s: Phoronix says the flaws were disclosed as the embargo lifted, with 25 more vulnerabilities expected, raising concerns for cloud GPU slice rentals

stories.h: Noctua launches NT-CP1 carbon nanotube thermal pad for AMD AM4/AM5 processors at $24.95
stories.s: The pad uses Carbice's vertically‑aligned carbon nanotubes, an aluminum backbone and a polymer coating, promising maintenance‑free performance for years and is sold for €24.95/$24.95.

stories.h: Tədqiqat Nvidia-nın 8 GB-lik mədən GPU-sunu 80 GB-lik A100 sinfi karta çevirən gərginlik qüsuru haker hücumunu aşkar edib
stories.s: Kate Nvidia-nın eFuse kontrollerinə yazmaq üçün gərginlik qüsuru üsulunu nümayiş etdirib, 80 GB-ə qədər VRAM və əlavə shader vahidlərini sərbəst buraxaraq A100-dən yüksək performans göstərmiş və qüsur haqqında Nvidia-nı məlumatlandırıb.
stories.he: Research reveals voltage‑glitch hack that turns Nvidia 8GB mining GPU into 80GB A100‑class card

stories.h: Intel Xe driver adds SR-IOV provisioning for vGPU profiles in upcoming Linux 7.5 kernel
stories.s: The new driver support will enable virtual GPU allocation via SR-IOV, allowing multiple VMs to share Intel graphics resources, announced by Intel for the Linux 7.5 cycle.

stories.h: Linux 7.5 adds HWMON driver for AMD Pensando NICs
stories.s: The new driver enables temperature, voltage and power monitoring for high‑end AMD Pensando networking hardware, expanding Linux kernel support for these devices.

stories.h: Microsoft closes 1,094 vulnerabilities in November 2026 Windows 11 Patchday and adds new right-click menu
stories.s: The update KB5132061 (build 26300.9974) addresses the vulnerabilities and introduces a new context‑menu UI, with Microsoft urging users to install promptly and restart as needed.

stories.h: Gigabyte launches AORUS ARI Bundle with RTX 5060 and B850 motherboard on Newegg
stories.s: The bundle pairs an RTX 5060 ARI 8G graphics card using Blackwell architecture with a B850 AORUS ELITE-P ICE AM5 motherboard supporting Ryzen 9000‑8000‑7000 CPUs, DDR5 up to 8200 MT/s, PCIe 5.0, Wi‑Fi 7 and 5 GbE LAN.

stories.h: İcma aləti xidmətləri deaktiv etmədən AMD Radeon SSD yazma xətəsini bloklayır
stories.s: Necandi açıq mənbəli alət olan Radeon-atieclxx-SSD-Fix-i yayımlayıb. Bu alət qüsurlu sürücü faylına SYSTEM yazma girişini qadağan edərək gündə 432 GB-a qədər yazma əməliyyatlarının qarşısını alır, eyni zamanda FreeSync və qısayolların işləməsini qoruyur.
stories.he: Community tool blocks AMD Radeon SSD write bug without disabling services

stories.h: AMD architect Mike Clark discusses Zen 6 and Zen 6c design details
stories.s: In an AMD In-Depth interview, Clark outlines Zen 6's 32 cores, 128 MB L3, larger vector scheduler, reduced integer multipliers and added VNNI units, highlighting AI and performance goals.

stories.h: AMD announces EPYC Venice-X with 96 cores and 5.3 GHz boost for HPC
stories.s: The upcoming Venice‑X CPU will use the SP7 socket, 96 PCIe 6.0 lanes and up to 1.6 TB/s memory bandwidth, targeting high‑frequency 3D V‑Cache workloads in data centers.

stories.h: Intel adds Linux kernel 7.5 support for upcoming GPU D-Series "Crescent Island"
stories.s: The upcoming Linux 7.5 kernel will include drivers for Intel's Xe3P-based AI accelerator, extending support for the yet‑unreleased GPU D Series.

stories.h: Zalman launches ALPHA3 A36 360 mm AIO coolers and ZM-HF120 fan series
stories.s: The new ALPHA3 LX A36 and SE A36 AIOs feature copper bases, ARGB fans and LCD or ARGB pump covers, while the ZM-HF120 fans offer fluid dynamic bearings and PWM control; pricing and availability were not disclosed.

stories.h: Intel 256 nüvəli Xeon 7 "Diamond Rapids" prosessorunun (CPU) ilk şəkillərini açıqladı
stories.s: Tencent Qlobal Rəqəmsal Ekosistem Konfransında nümayiş etdirilən çip 256 Panther Cove P-nüvəsi, 1.28 GB L3 keş, 12,800 MT/s-ə qədər 16 yaddaş kanalı və 128 PCIe Gen 6 xəttinə malikdir. Süni intellekt infrastrukturuna yönələn bu məhsulun 2027-ci ildə buraxılması planlaşdırılır.
stories.he: Intel unveils first photos of 256-core Xeon 7 "Diamond Rapids" CPU

stories.h: TrendForce proqnozuna görə, OEM-lərin yaddaş təchizatını tənzimləməsi fonunda 2026-cı ilin IV rübündə PC DRAM müqavilə qiymətləri rübdən rübə 13-18% artacaq
stories.s: Yaddaş xərclərinin artması PC OEM-lərini sifarişləri irəli çəkməyə və 2027-ci il üçün aşağı spesifikasiyalı yaddaş planlaşdırmağa vadar edib, eyni zamanda 2026-cı ilin III rübündə noutbuk çatdırılmaları rübdən rübə 15.8% azalıb.
stories.he: TrendForce forecasts PC DRAM contract prices to rise 13-18% QoQ in 4Q26 as OEMs adjust memory procurement

stories.h: Microsoft design lead says WinUI 3 will modernize legacy Windows 11 dialogs
stories.s: Ash confirmed work on updating tools like Control Panel, Disk Cleanup and Device Manager, but gave no timeline or specific tools, noting the effort is ongoing.

stories.h: AMD EPYC 9006 Venice and 9996 256-core CPUs benchmarked against NVIDIA Vera and Intel Xeon Granite Rapids
stories.s: Phoronix reports hundreds of HPC workload tests comparing the newly launched EPYC 9006 Venice, EPYC 9996 256-core, and EPYC 9686F 96-core CPUs with NVIDIA's Vera and Intel's Xeon Granite Rapids.

stories.h: Lenovo Japan unveils Yoga 9n 2-in-1 Gen 11 with RTX Spark N1X and 64GB unified memory
stories.s: The 16-inch convertible launches on 27 November in Japan for ¥912,780 (≈US$5,747) and features a NVIDIA Grace‑CPU/Blackwell‑GPU platform, 6,144 GPU cores, and a 2.8K OLED display with 30–120 Hz refresh.

stories.h: Biostar launches BIPTL-IHT Edge AI Mini-ITX motherboard with Intel Core Ultra processors
stories.s: The board supports dual DDR5-7200 SO-DIMM up to 128 GB, dual 2.5 GbE LAN, multiple M.2 slots and up to four display outputs, targeting AIoT and industrial automation markets.

stories.h: Montech launches King 95 3D case and 3D Pro version at $119.90 and $199.90
stories.s: The new mid‑tower adds a tempered‑glass top panel, three‑pane panoramic view and optional pre‑installed Link Fan INF 120 fans, but lacks E‑ATX support.

stories.h: AMD opens Mesa merge request adding primitive GFX13 support to RADV and RadeonSI drivers
stories.s: The merge introduces initial GFX13 code for Vulkan and OpenGL, following earlier AMDGPU Linux driver patches released earlier this week.

stories.h: Chieftec launches ATLAS E-ATX workstation case with eight PCIe slots and support for 450mm GPUs
stories.s: The new ATLAS chassis includes four pre‑installed 140mm PWM fans, room for radiators up to 420mm, and space for up to five 3.5‑inch drives, but pricing and availability are not yet disclosed.

stories.h: AMD says its MEXT tech can keep 95% server performance at 50% DRAM capacity
stories.s: AMD claims the AI‑driven memory offload system MEXT lets servers run at half the physical DRAM while retaining 95% of performance, based on internal tests on workloads like Synopsys PrimeTime.

stories.h: Elon Musk's SpaceX plans $24 billion gas‑powered AI supercomputer in Starbase, Texas
stories.s: SpaceX will hold a public hearing for a gas‑fired power plant and supercomputing facility in Starbase, facing possible resistance from Governor Gina Hinojosa and local opposition.

stories.h: AMD releases AOCC 6.0 compiler alongside EPYC 9006 Venice processors
stories.s: The new AOCC 6.0 adds Zen 6 optimizations, a new "aof" Fortran compiler and rebrands aoc/aoc++ as part of AMD's LLVM/Clang stack, announced with the EPYC 9996 and EPYC 9686F launch.

stories.h: Intel releases microcode-20261110 update for Core Gen 13 and Xeon Sapphire Rapids CPUs
stories.s: The update, announced on Tuesday, adds new microcode binaries for recent Intel Core (Ultra) and Xeon processors, addressing a range of functional issues.

stories.h: ASUS unveils ProArt GR1X mini PC, P16 & P14 AI laptops and OLED monitors at Adobe MAX 2026
stories.s: The new GR1X features a 6144‑core Blackwell RTX GPU, up to 128 GB unified memory and AI agent capabilities, while the P16 and P14 laptops combine up to 6,144 RTX cores, a 20‑core Grace CPU and 128 GB memory in thin, portable designs; OLED displays offer 4K, 120 Hz and Delta E<1.5 color accuracy.

stories.h: AMD 256-ya qədər nüvəli, 7 illik ömürlü EPYC Embedded 9006 seriyasını təqdim etdi
stories.s: Zen 6 əsaslı prosessorlar PCIe 6.0 və CXL 3.1 standartlarını dəstəkləyir, saxlama, şəbəkə və sənaye sistemləri üçün nəzərdə tutulub. AMD 7 illik məhsul ömrü müddətinə zəmanət verir.
stories.he: AMD launches EPYC Embedded 9006 series with up to 256 cores and seven-year longevity

stories.h: Stormcraft PC launches Fantasy Series prebuilt gaming desktops with up to Ryzen 7 7800X3D and RTX 5070
stories.s: The California brand offers ten configurations across Intel and AMD platforms, featuring 32 GB DDR5 memory, 1 TB PCIe Gen 4 SSDs and prices that may vary by retailer.

stories.h: Corsair releases pink versions of its 3500X and FRAME 4000D cases
stories.s: The new editions add upgraded RS II ARGB fans and will ship in North America on November 10, 2026 with global availability in December, priced at $139.99 and $134.99 respectively.

stories.h: Microsoft removes PC-to-PC migration feature in Windows 11 update KB5127648
stories.s: The local transfer option was discontinued in October 2026, forcing users to rely on Windows Backup via OneDrive, which requires a Microsoft account and limited free storage.

stories.h: Microsoft patents system to pay users for idle GPU compute
stories.s: The patent describes a voluntary platform that splits AI workloads into subtasks and rewards participants with financial compensation, software access or account credits, but provides no payout details.

stories.h: Otto launches Otto One, a screenless personal AI computer for autonomous agents
stories.s: The device runs Otto OS on an AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 processor, lets users control agents via phone or desktop, and sold 15,000 units generating $9 million in its first six months.

stories.h: Microsoft lobbies against FCC's potential ban on Chinese optical transceivers for AI data centers
stories.s: The company met with the White House OSTP and NSC, citing that a ban could halve global supply and stall AI chip rollout, while U.S. makers lack scale to fill the gap.

stories.h: AMD releases initial Linux driver patches for GFX13 graphics core
stories.s: The eight‑patch series adds graphics engine, MES, IMU, compute support and clock‑gating for GFX13.0.1 and 13.0.4, but provides no specifications or launch timeline.

stories.h: AMD confirms 7th‑Gen EPYC "Florence" and 8th‑Gen EPYC "Ravenna" CPUs
stories.s: AMD announced the upcoming 7th‑Gen EPYC "Florence" and 8th‑Gen EPYC "Ravenna" during its briefing, following the 6th‑Gen EPYC SP7 launch.

stories.h: AMD Zen 6 arxitekturalı EPYC 9006 "Venice" serverlərini təqdim etdi – IPC göstəricisində 27%-dək artım
stories.s: Yeni EPYC 9996 256-çəhrəhli prosessor 1,024 iş parçacığı təmin edir və SPEC CPU 2026 emalı göstəricisində 768 iş parçacıklı EPYC 9965-dən 93% üstünlük təşkil edir, EPYC 9686F isə elmi və HPC yüklərinə yönəlmişdir.
stories.he: AMD unveils EPYC 9006 "Venice" servers with Zen 6 architecture delivering up to 27% IPC uplift

stories.h: AMD launches MEXT software to expand server memory using flash storage
stories.s: AMD says the tool adds tens of terabytes of effective memory and cuts expansion costs versus buying extra DRAM, but performance depends on workload and SSD endurance.

stories.h: Gigabyte launches AI TOP AERO desktop with NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X Superchip
stories.s: The new AI TOP AERO combines a 20‑core NVIDIA Grace CPU, Blackwell RTX GPU, up to 128 GB LPDDR5x unified memory and up to 4 TB PCIe Gen 5 SSD in a ~1‑liter chassis, targeting local AI development, content creation and gaming.

stories.h: Aomei Backupper Standard 8.5 offers free backup but boot media creation is problematic
stories.s: The review notes full-featured backup capabilities at no cost, but creating a bootable recovery USB requires lowering BIOS security and using third‑party tools like Rufus 4.8.

stories.h: Gigabyte UD850GM PG5 V2 850W PSU reviewed at £90 with 80 PLUS Gold rating
stories.s: The fully modular unit, featuring 100% Japanese capacitors and a smart hydraulic bearing fan, received Cybenetics Platinum efficiency testing and includes a 10‑year warranty where offered.

stories.h: NZXT launches C1000 Platinum 1000W PSU with ATX 3.1 and 16‑pin GPU connector
stories.s: The new fully modular unit is 80 PLUS Platinum certified, priced at €179.90/$179.99, and adds a native 16‑pin 12V‑2x6 connector rated up to 600W, plus a 10‑year warranty.

stories.h: NZXT launches refreshed H7 and H5 mid‑tower cases with single‑piece curved glass and new Kraken liquid coolers
stories.s: The H7 and H5 now feature Vista Mode glass covering front, side and top, swappable mesh tops and support for up to 495 mm GPUs, while the Kraken Plus 360 RGB adds a customizable display and the Core series uses Asetek pumps.

stories.h: NZXT launches H7 RGB+ mid‑tower case at $259.99 with pre‑installed RGB fans
stories.s: The H7 RGB+ adds three F420 RGB Reverse fans, an F140 rear fan and a Control Hub Lite, while the base H7 starts at $159.99; both models support ATX, micro‑ATX and Mini‑ITX builds and offer Vista or Aero top panels.

stories.h: ASRock RX 7900 XT/XTX kartlarının işlək vəziyyətdən çıxması problemini aradan qaldırmaq üçün VBIOS flash aləti 1.0.6 versiyasını yayımlayıb
stories.s: Bu yeniləmə 1.0.5 versiyasının bəzi RX 7900 XT və XTX kartlarının işə düşməməsinə səbəb olduğu barədə məlumatlardan sonra yayımlanıb. ASRock dəyişikliklər siyahısını açıqlamayıb və düzəlişin tam olduğunu təsdiqləməyib.
stories.he: ASRock releases VBIOS flash utility 1.0.6 to address RX 7900 XT/XTX bricking issue

stories.h: MSI launches the MEG X 34-inch 360 Hz QD‑OLED gaming monitor
stories.s: The flagship monitor features a 5th‑Gen QD‑OLED panel with Penta Tandem technology, AI‑driven visual/audio tools and a SpectrumBar+ lighting strip, plus DisplayPort 2.1a, HDMI 2.1 and USB‑C with up to 98 W PD.

stories.h: Seagate launches FireCuda Forge external hybrid drive requiring user‑installed NVMe SSD
stories.s: The 8TB and 20TB Forge combines a high‑capacity HDD with a user‑supplied M.2 2280 SSD via Seagate's Alkemi platform, offering adaptive caching but performance caps at PCIe Gen3 SSDs.

stories.h: Rapidus may miss 2 nm volume production timeline due to SRAM and cleanroom issues
stories.s: Japan Times reports the Japanese fab is facing SRAM cell failures and dust control problems that could push high‑volume production from fiscal 2027 to later months, though Rapidus still claims the node will arrive on time.

stories.h: AMD and Intel release ACE v2 and AVX10.3 specifications and GCC patches
stories.s: The x86 Ecosystem Advisory Group published the specs and early compiler support, but no processors with the extensions are expected until 2028‑2029.

stories.h: AMD releases Project Zenith developer setup for Ryzen AI Halo workstations
stories.s: The Windows 11 configuration, built with Microsoft, includes VS Code, Git tools, Azure CLI and AI Playbooks and is available on new Halo systems via Micro Center, with a script for existing owners.

stories.h: NVIDIA: RTX 5090 GB202 istehsalı davam edir, lakin təchizat məhdud qalır
stories.s: Şəxsi Kompüter üzrə İcraçı Vise Prezident Jeff Fisher qeyd etdi ki, waferlərin paylanması və lojistika dövri partiya ilə çatdırılmalara səbəb olur, korporativ tələbat isə kartları pərakəndə satış kanallarından cəlb edir, buna görə də mövcudluq gələn rübə qədər məhdud qalacaq.
stories.he: NVIDIA says RTX 5090 GB202 production remains active but supply stays constrained

stories.h: Ocypus launches limited-edition Omega L36 Ultra 360mm AIO cooler priced at $399.99
stories.s: Only 200 units will be produced worldwide; the cooler features a dynamic thermal system that expands to direct airflow over VRMs, claiming up to 10 °C temperature reduction.

stories.h: Nvidia requires 51% of cloud AI GPU rentals to go to non‑Chinese firms, tightening overseas access for Chinese labs
stories.s: The rule, conveyed verbally to global cloud partners, limits new leases and adds tracking for Southeast Asian providers, while Chinese firms have already bought over 1 million export‑compliant cards and face higher costs for rentals abroad.

stories.h: MSI launches Crosshair A16 HX MLG Edition laptop with Ryzen 9 8940HX and RTX 5070 in the UK
stories.s: The UK‑available model is priced at £2,299.99, features a 16‑inch 2560×1600 240 Hz panel, 16 GB DDR5, 1 TB SSD and up to 96 GB RAM, and includes an MLG mouse, headset and mouse‑mat bundle.

stories.h: Terafab aims to produce 1 million wafers per month by 2032, 700 000 for memory
stories.s: The Tesla‑SpaceX joint venture plans a Texas fab targeting 1 M wafers monthly, with Intel aiding logic and a Taiwanese partner likely for memory, but production dates remain uncertain.

stories.h: QNAP launches ES2486AFdc 24‑bay active‑active NVMe all‑flash storage array
stories.s: The ES2486AFdc features dual Intel Xeon D 8‑core CPUs, up to 512 GB DDR4 ECC per controller, 24 U.2/U.3 NVMe slots and ZFS‑based QES OS for zero data loss, targeting enterprise virtualization and databases.

stories.h: DapuStor launches J5101 enterprise NVMe M.2 boot drive with up to 1.92 TB capacity
stories.s: The J5101 uses PCIe Gen 4, consumes 2 W idle and 4.5 W active, and offers power‑loss protection and secure boot for AI, HPC and cloud servers.

stories.h: Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AI reviewed with RTX 5070 Ti and Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus
stories.s: Tom's Hardware rates the thin‑and‑light laptop at $2,774.99, noting solid gaming performance but below‑average battery life, and highlights its 240 Hz OLED display and 115 W RTX 5070 Ti.

stories.h: Reviewer finds Alienware AW3926QW 39-inch OLED monitor unsuitable as a full replacement for triple-monitor setup
stories.s: The author notes the monitor's high pixel density and excellent visuals but cites limited horizontal space and workflow disruption, recommending additional screens for multitasking.

stories.h: Huawei launches Qinyun HM650 desktop PCs with 10‑core Kirin X90 processor and HarmonyOS
stories.s: The systems feature 16 GB LPDDR5, 256 GB or 512 GB SSDs and a 7nm‑class SMIC‑manufactured SoC, aiming for fully domestic components despite foreign tooling.

stories.h: HP OmniBook 5 reviewed at $699.99 with Intel Core i5, 8GB RAM and OLED display
stories.s: The review notes premium build, excellent battery life, but criticizes the non‑upgradeable 8GB RAM and limited storage, while performance scores show solid productivity but modest graphics.

stories.h: AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D hits record low price of $399.99
stories.s: The 8‑core, 16‑thread Zen 5 CPU is now $399.99 at Newegg and Amazon after applying coupons, offering strong gaming performance per watt.

stories.h: AMD Radeon sürücüsündəki xəta SSD-yə davamlı yazma əməliyyatlarına səbəb olur
stories.s: AMD təsdiqləyib ki, Adrenalin 26.10.1/26.10.2-dəki External Events Utility boş vaxtda belə 5 MB/s-ə qədər yazma həyata keçirir, bu da SSD-lərin ömrünü qısalda bilər. Düzəliş növbəti sürücü buraxılışında planlaşdırılıb.
stories.he: AMD Radeon driver bug causes continuous SSD writes

stories.h: G.Skill Ripjaws V DDR4-3200 32 GB kit drops to $209.99 at Newegg
stories.s: The kit (model F4-3200C16D-32GVK) offers 3200 MT/s speed, 16‑cycle latency and a lifetime warranty, targeting builders facing high memory and GPU prices.

stories.h: ASUS lists Zenbook 16 Air Snapdragon 24GB/1TB model at $1,879
stories.s: The Chinese retail listing shows the 16‑inch OLED laptop with Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme 3nm 18‑core CPU, 24 GB LPDDR5X, 1 TB SSD and 120 Hz display priced around $1,879.

stories.h: Two Chinese firms approved for Nvidia H200 AI chips have empty offices, raising US export license concerns
stories.s: Investigation found New Matrix and Maginfra offices were vacant and their links to sanctioned entities unclear, prompting criticism of the Commerce Department’s due‑diligence, said former NSC China director Liza Tobin.

stories.h: Dell PowerEdge R770AP server review details dual Intel Xeon 6980P CPUs and 32 E3.S NVMe bays
stories.s: The 2U air‑cooled R770AP supports up to two 128‑core Xeon 6980P processors, 32 E3.S Gen5 NVMe drives and redundant 1.8 kW power supplies, with iDRAC management and OCP NIC 3.0 networking.

stories.h: Logitech G502 X Lightspeed reviewed at $159.99 with upgraded Hero 44K sensor
stories.s: Tom's Hardware notes the mouse retains the same price as the G502 X Plus, adds a firmware upgrade to a Hero 44K sensor, and highlights its performance and ergonomics.

stories.h: Maxsun unveils Panther Lake and Wildcat Lake NAS motherboards with Intel Core Ultra CPUs
stories.s: The SK-PTLNAS supports up to 128 GB DDR5‑7200, PCIe 5.0 x8, 10 GbE and Thunderbolt 4, while the SK-WCLAIO offers 48 GB DDR5‑6400, 1 TB UFS 3.1 and four M.2 slots; pricing is still unknown.

stories.h: Microsoft VP Scott Hanselman releases open-source GPU task manager gputaskman
stories.s: The tool runs on Windows, Linux and macOS, showing per‑process GPU usage, VRAM consumption and AI model details, with the latest v0.3.0 portable Windows build available on GitHub.

stories.h: DRAM qiymətləri kəskin artdıqca 64GB PC yaddaş konfiqurasiyaları 18% azalıb
stories.s: CPU-Z məlumatlarına görə, 64GB konfiqurasiyalarda illik 18% kəskin azalma qeydə alınıb, 16GB və 8GB konfiqurasiyalar isə bərpa olub. Bu, DDR4 və DDR5 qiymətlərinin kəskin artdığı şəraitdə istehlakçıların yüksək tutumlu RAM-dan uzaq durduğunu əks etdirir.
stories.he: 64GB PC memory configurations fell 18% as DRAM prices surge

stories.h: Linux kernel updates address BHI vulnerability mitigation issue
stories.s: The upcoming Linux 7.4-rc2 release includes patches correcting faulty mitigation selection for the BHI CPU vulnerability, improving system security.

stories.h: CPU-Z data shows 16 GB RAM share up while 32 GB and 64 GB shares fall year‑over‑year
stories.s: The validator reports 16 GB configurations rising 12.9% to 33.0% and 8 GB up 5.5%, while 32 GB drops 2.5% and 64 GB falls 18%, with DDR4 share increasing and DDR5 slipping.

stories.h: iBuyPower Slate gaming PC drops to $899 with $500 discount
stories.s: The prebuilt features an AMD Ryzen 5 8400F, Nvidia RTX 5060, 16GB DDR5 RAM and 1TB NVMe SSD, down from $1,399 at Best Buy.

stories.h: ASRock Rack unveils DMRD16-2L+ motherboard with 16 DDR5 slots for Intel Diamond Rapids Xeon
stories.s: The EEB board supports up to 4 TB DDR5 using 16 DIMM slots, offers 128 PCIe Gen6/CXL 3.0 lanes via MCIO connectors, and includes an ASPEED AST2700 BMC, but pricing and availability are not disclosed yet.

stories.h: Tom's Hardware previews Micron 2026 roadmap and Apple PROLED display plans
stories.s: The weekly premium roundup details Micron's announced DRAM and 11th‑Gen NAND roadmap, Apple's intent to launch a touch‑enabled PROLED display in 2026, and other industry interviews.

stories.h: TeamGroup GA Pro 2TB PCIe 5.0 SSD reviewed at $331.99 with poor performance
stories.s: Tom's Hardware found the drive's efficiency low, temperatures high and performance below expectations despite its 10,000/8,500 MB/s specs, recommending it only on steep sale.

stories.h: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned to US Congress over alleged Chinese espionage ties
stories.s: Republican representatives cited a NYT report linking Megaspeed exec Alice Huang to Chinese intelligence and requested a closed‑door briefing on Nvidia's security protocols.

stories.h: NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti-nin qiyməti 8 gündə $160 artıb, indi MSRP-dən 79% yuxarıdır
stories.s: ABŞ-da ən ucuz təklif $1,339.99-dür, $1,179.99-dan artaraq, Almaniya qiymətləri isə MSRP-dən təxminən 48% yuxarıdır, Çinli plaka tərəfdaşları isə qiymətlərin daha da artırılmasını planlaşdırır.
stories.he: NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti price climbs $160 in eight days, now 79% above MSRP

stories.h: GlobalFoundries unveils FDX Fusion FD-SOI process promising 7nm-class performance without EUV
stories.s: VP Sudipto Bose said the new 8nm-class logic density node targets connectivity, edge AI MCUs, automotive radar and data‑center RF, with commercial production planned for 2028.

stories.h: Nvidia requires Southeast Asian cloud providers to register with Fleet Intelligence to retain Nvidia Cloud Partner status
stories.s: The move, reported by Bloomberg, adds a tracking mandate for AI GPUs amid concerns of chip smuggling into China, though participation remains voluntary outside the new requirement.

stories.h: Six pallets of Nvidia GPUs worth $11.4 million stolen in California cargo heist
stories.s: The shipment left Oakland for Texas on August 29 and was lost in San Bernardino County, prompting concerns over security of high‑value hardware shipments.

stories.h: INNOCN 45C1R 44.5‑inch 32:9 monitor launches at just under $550
stories.s: The VA panel offers 5120×1440 resolution, 120 Hz DP/USB‑C refresh, 65 W USB‑C PD and built‑in speakers, targeting a more compact ultrawide desktop setup.

stories.h: Nagare Labs unveils Z2RAM memory with SRAM speed and DRAM density claims
stories.s: The Georgia Tech spinout projects Gen 1 Z2RAM to deliver 14× DRAM speed, 5× SRAM density and 3× lower read energy, with retention over 300 s at 85 °C, using a two‑transistor cell built on standard 300 mm DUV tools.

stories.h: Steam survey shows 16 GB RAM overtakes 32 GB and RTX 3060 leads GPU rankings in October 2026
stories.s: Valve’s October 2026 hardware survey reports 16 GB systems as the most common configuration and the RTX 3060 as the top graphics card, though exact percentages are not provided.

stories.h: AMD Medusa Point engineering sample scores 3,100 single-core and 18,313 multi-core in Geekbench 7
stories.s: The Lenovo test platform with 55.58 GB DDR5 at 5,188 MT/s showed a 10‑core 4+6 hybrid layout, 16 MB L3 cache, and AVX‑512 support, but AMD has not confirmed specifications or release timing.

stories.h: Alienware releases firmware update adding CPC edge‑dimming toggle for AW3926QW monitor
stories.s: The Dell‑provided update lets owners disable Convex Power Control via the monitor’s OSD, addressing complaints about vignette‑like edge dimming on the 39‑inch OLED panel.

stories.h: Bluetooth SIG adopts Core 7.0 HDT, raising BLE max rate to 7.5 Mbit/s
stories.s: The optional High Data Throughput feature, adopted on Nov 4 2026, will appear in devices starting in 2027 and aims to enable lossless audio and faster data sync, but requires compatible hardware and firmware.

stories.h: MSI launches 24.5-inch MAG 256QR36 gaming monitor with 1440p resolution and 360 Hz refresh
stories.s: The new monitor features a Rapid IPS panel, 0.5 ms GtG response, DisplayHDR 400, and supports both FreeSync Premium and G‑Sync Compatible, but pricing and regional availability are not yet disclosed.

stories.h: NVIDIA RTX PRO 5500 listed at $17,999, $1,400 above RTX PRO 6000
stories.s: SHI Government Solutions shows the PNY-built RTX PRO 5500 at $17,999 (discounted $17,408.63) while the higher‑spec RTX PRO 6000 sells for $16,000, despite fewer CUDA cores and memory.

stories.h: Supermicro releases Super AI Station workstation with NVIDIA Grace 72‑Core CPU and Blackwell Ultra GPU
stories.s: The ARS‑511GD‑NB‑LCC offers 496 GB LPDDR5X system memory, 252 GB HBM3E GPU memory, 1600 W PSU and 2×400 Gbps networking, targeting desk‑side AI workloads.

stories.h: Beelink launches modular ME Pro NAS on Kickstarter
stories.s: The ME Pro offers swappable Intel and AMD motherboard modules, up to four drive bays, 34 dB noise and up to 86 TOPS AI performance, with early‑bird offers now live.

stories.h: CPU-Z 3.02 adds Intel Razor Lake support
stories.s: The update detects the upcoming Razor Lake family, though Intel has not officially announced details, and also adds AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 and fixes for Intel Broadwell-E SPD reading.

stories.h: OpenSSH and musl-libc bug lets anyone log into Alpine Linux by typing over 256 characters as password
stories.s: The combined flaw affects OpenSSH and musl's crypt() function, allowing passwordless access on default Alpine installations and other distros; a fix has been released and admins should disable PasswordAuthentication immediately

stories.h: India aims to develop its own GPU within two years, says MeitY secretary
stories.s: S. Krishnan outlined the goal under the India Semiconductor Mission 2.0, targeting a domestic GPU chip in about 24 months, alongside broader AI ecosystem plans.

stories.h: PCWorld reviews top Thunderbolt docks, naming Kensington SD5780T as best overall
stories.s: The article evaluates dozens of Thunderbolt 4/5 docks, highlighting the Kensington Thunderbolt 4 Dual 4K Dock (SD5780T) at about $250 and the StarTech Quad Display Dock at $204 as top picks.

stories.h: be quiet! releases Light Mount TKL silent mechanical keyboard
stories.s: TechPowerUp reviewed the new 87-key TKL keyboard featuring silent switches, sound damping, RGB lighting and SOCD, noting it is cheaper than the earlier Dark Mount model.

stories.h: Qualcomm's Dragonwing platforms selected for SpaceX Starlink Mobile 5G network
stories.s: Qualcomm will supply QRU100 and QDU100 Massive MIMO radio units for a multi-year, tens‑of‑thousands‑site US rollout starting in 2027, improving performance per watt and network economics.

stories.h: Qualcomm reports 36% YoY growth in QCT Automotive and IoT revenues for Q4 2026
stories.s: CEO Cristiano Amon said non‑handset revenues are projected to grow over 60% YoY and the company reaffirmed its FY2027 data‑center revenue target of $5 billion.

stories.h: UPERFECT GR14BU portable monitor launches with 3K OLED panel and 120 Hz refresh at under $300
stories.s: Tom's Hardware measured a peak brightness of 368.6 nits versus the claimed 500 nits and noted the tiny kickstand limits the unit to landscape mode, while praising its color coverage and value pricing.

stories.h: Apple releases MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR display starting at $3,399
stories.s: The 16‑inch model with OLED screen and Dynamic Island weighs 4.1 lb and starts at $3,399, while the 14‑inch starts at $2,899, featuring M5 Max/Pro chips and up to 128 GB memory.

stories.h: Apple launches 14‑inch MacBook Pro with M6 chip at $1,999
stories.s: The new model adds Wi‑Fi 7, Bluetooth 6 and a 12‑core GPU, delivering 10% higher single‑core and 18% higher multi‑core Geekbench scores than the M5, according to Tom's Hardware.

stories.h: Nintendo Switch 2 shipments fell 41% to 2.67 million units in Q3
stories.s: Software sales rose 26% to 15.03 million units, boosting digital revenue, while hardware decline is linked to memory and storage supply constraints.

stories.h: MK Rigs releases Macchina mini-ITX prebuilt with Ryzen 5 7500F and RX 9060 XT for £1339
stories.s: The system features 16GB DDR5 5200MHz RAM, 1TB QLC SSD, 750W Platinum SFX PSU and Windows 11, targeting 1440p gaming at a competitive price.

stories.h: Thermalright unveils TR-A70 Vision V2 glass-box case with wooden front and integrated display
stories.s: The new case adds a wooden front panel and a built‑in screen, though dimensions, motherboard support, cooling clearances, display specs and price were not disclosed in the listing.

stories.h: Samsung announces PM1763 enterprise SSD with PCIe 6.0 x4 and 28.4 GB/s read speed
stories.s: The drive uses PAM4 signaling and requires mandatory liquid cooling blocks; mass production is planned for Q4 2026 with availability in Q1 2027.

stories.h: Intel releases Arc GPU driver version 101.9175 WHQL
stories.s: The update adds game optimizations for Football Manager 27, Phantom Blade Zero and World of Warcraft: Forever, and fixes crashes and performance issues in several titles and Intel graphics software.

stories.h: NVIDIA releases CUDA 13.5 with GA support for Vera Rubin GPUs
stories.s: The update arrives alongside driver version 620.70.06 for Linux, enabling developers to use the new features on Vera Rubin hardware.

stories.h: SEMI reports worldwide silicon wafer shipments rose 13.4% YoY to 3,756 MSI in Q3 2026
stories.s: The increase was driven by strong AI‑related demand and industrial growth, with shipments also up 5.1% QoQ from Q2 2026, according to SEMI SMG chairman Masatsugu Miura.

stories.h: Macronix to phase out ROM division used for Nintendo Switch cartridges
stories.s: Analyst David Gibson says ROM chips made up 5% of Macronix's revenue this quarter, down from 26% a year earlier, and the company will stop reporting ROM sales after the current quarter.

stories.h: MSI launches Cubi NUC WCG mini PC with Intel Core 3 Series processor
stories.s: The 0.55‑liter device offers Thunderbolt 4 up to 40 Gbps, Wi‑Fi 6E, dual LAN and a tool‑less chassis for easy maintenance, targeting business and commercial use.

stories.h: Four Radeon RX 470-class GPUs spotted on a single PCIe board
stories.s: Photos show a large PCB with four Polaris GPUs, a PCIe Gen 2 switch and multiple power connectors, but AMD has not confirmed the product or its intended use.

stories.h: Linux 7.4 kernel shows modest performance changes on AMD Ryzen Threadripper 9980X
stories.s: Initial benchmarks on a System76 Thelio Major workstation reveal small gains and minor regressions compared to the stable Linux 7.3 kernel.

stories.h: CyberPowerPC UK cuts prices on gaming PCs and laptops for Black Friday
stories.s: Discounts of up to £300 are offered on models like the VIVID Gaming PC BF2606 now £2,399 and the MSI Crosshair 16 laptop now £1,599, with the sale running through Cyber Monday.

stories.h: AMD expects client PC shipments to fall double‑digit percent in 2027
stories.s: CEO Dr. Lisa Su said higher GPU memory and RAM prices are squeezing demand, while AMD plans to raise Radeon GPU and GDDR6 prices again in November.

stories.h: Logitech G Pro X3 Superstrike mouse priced at $199.99
stories.s: Tom's Hardware notes the new NxLOGI chipset, 8,000 Hz polling and a 2‑gram weight reduction, but finds the $200 price hard to justify for most gamers.

stories.h: Thermal Grizzly launches PhaseSheet PTM Pro thermal pad at $23.28
stories.s: The new 40 × 40 mm pad offers higher thermal conductivity and an easier‑to‑peel carrier, achieving a 5.83 °C temperature drop under 240 W load, compared to earlier pads.

stories.h: Micron outlines DRAM roadmap with 1δ production slated for H2 2027
stories.s: The company will use wafer bonding, High-NA EUV and new materials for its next‑gen 1δ DRAM, aiming for ~mid‑20% density gain, and plans future 3D DRAM generations, though dates are unannounced.

stories.h: Nvidia RTX Spark laptops benchmarked, showing AI performance advantage over desktop GPUs
stories.s: PCWorld tested the $7,000 Asus ProArt P16, HP OmniBook Ultra and Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra, finding the unified memory architecture lets the laptops run large AI models faster than a RTX 5090 desktop, though gaming performance lags behind conventional GPUs.

stories.h: Google reports backdoor in 1.3 million Android TV set‑top boxes by Videostrong Technology
stories.s: The OEM installed unauthorized malware, sold access to criminal affiliates for ad fraud and proxy networks, and Google has cut ties with the company and banned future devices with preloaded Google apps

stories.h: AMD projects Q4 revenue around $17 billion, aiming to outsell Intel for the first time
stories.s: The guidance puts AMD's revenue above Intel's $15‑$16 billion range, driven by a 97% YoY rise in data‑center sales, while client and gaming sales are expected to fall over 20%.

stories.h: ASUS announces ROG XG Station 3 external graphics dock with Thunderbolt 5
stories.s: The open‑frame eGPU dock supports up to 80 Gbps (120 Gbps with Bandwidth Boost) and can power BTF 2.5 cards like the RTX 5080 and RTX 5090, but ASUS has not disclosed price, availability or its own PSU rating.

stories.h: ASRock Radeon RX 7900 XTX kartları VBIOS yeniləməsindən sonra işə düşməyə bilər
stories.s: Reddit istifadəçiləri bildirirlər ki, bəzi RX 7900 XTX Phantom Gaming kartları ASRVBFlash 1.0.5 quraşdırdıqdan sonra işə düşmür. Məsələ AMD-nin AMD‑SN‑6023 təhlükəsizlik məsələsi ilə əlaqələndirilir, lakin AMD bildirir ki, hazırda heç bir eksploit müşahidə edilməyib.
stories.he: ASRock Radeon RX 7900 XTX cards may fail to boot after VBIOS update

stories.h: AMD reports record $13.4 billion Q3 2026 revenue
stories.s: Revenue rose 45% YoY to $13.4 billion, driven by an $8.5 billion Data Center segment, while Gaming fell 40% to $773 million.

stories.h: Kioxia launches Exceria G3 4TB PCIe 5.0 SSD with up to 10,000 MB/s read
stories.s: The drive uses a Phison E31T DRAM‑less controller with up to 64 MB HMB, offers 2,400 TBW endurance and is priced around €280 for the 2TB model, with 4TB pricing not yet set.

stories.h: DeepCool launches S360 AIO cooler with 6.67-inch 2K AMOLED pump display
stories.s: The Chinese‑priced S360 costs ¥1,499 (about $223) and is rated for 320 W thermal capacity, supporting Intel Socket V and AMD AM5/AM4 platforms.

stories.h: AOC unveiled the Agon Ultra AGP277UZD 26.5" OLED monitor with 4K 240Hz and 1080p 480Hz modes
stories.s: The Chinese‑market monitor uses a tandem WOLED panel, 0.03 ms response, 10‑bit colour, 1,500,000:1 contrast and supports DisplayPort 2.1, HDMI 2.1 and USB‑C with 98 W PD, but pricing and Western availability are not yet announced.

stories.h: RTX 5090-un qiyməti oktyabrda $7,240-ə yüksəlib — MSRP-dən 262% yuxarı
stories.s: TechSpot-un araşdırmasına görə, RTX 5090-un normallaşdırılmış qlobal qiyməti bir ayda 32% artaraq $7,240-ə çatıb, ABŞ-da anbarlarda olan modellərin qiyməti isə MSRP-dən 370% yuxarı olan $9,400-ə yüksəlib.
stories.he: RTX 5090 price climbs to $7,240, 262% above MSRP in October

stories.h: Sudokoo SK700V MACH air cooler reviewed with digital display and seven heat pipes
stories.s: TechPowerUp details its dimensions, fan specs and L-Rail mount, noting a 0 RPM mode below 5% PWM and a five‑year warranty.

stories.h: PCWorld lists four 2026 gaming laptops including Alienware 16X Aurora and Acer Nitro V 16
stories.s: The roundup highlights specs like Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX and RTX 5070 in the Alienware, and a Ryzen 5 240 CPU with RTX 5050 in the Acer, noting performance, price and portability details.

stories.h: Intel Core Ultra 200H və 200U prosessorlarını gömülü bazarına yönəldir, 2027-ci ilin noyabrından sonra istehlakçıya çatdırılmaları dayandırır
stories.s: Sifarişlər 2027-ci ilin 21 mayadək verilməlidir, son çatdırılmalar isə 2027-ci ilin 19 noyabrına qədər həyata keçirilməlidir; bundan sonra bu SKU-lar kommersiya məqsədləri üçün satılmayacaq.
stories.he: Intel shifts Core Ultra 200H and 200U CPUs to embedded market, ending consumer shipments after Nov 2027

stories.h: BOSGAME launches M5 MAX mini workstation with AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495 and 192GB LPDDR5 for $6,199
stories.s: The compact system includes a 2TB PCIe 4.0 SSD, Wi‑Fi 7, dual 10GbE ports and a three‑fan cooling design, but dimensions, OS and warranty details are still pending.

stories.h: Global semiconductor sales hit $517.7 billion in Q3 2026, up 24.1% QoQ
stories.s: The Semiconductor Industry Association reported a 24.1% quarter‑to‑quarter rise and a 146.8% year‑over‑year jump for September sales, driven by growth across all major regions.

stories.h: FSP launches 1200W Gold non-modular PSU model FSP1200-50ADA
stories.s: The new unit complies with ATX 3.1, offers up to 90% efficiency, includes OVP/OCP/OTP protection and a 100,000‑hour MTBF, targeting RTX 5090 and AI workstations.

stories.h: Apple says memory costs rose, adding $33 billion to its manufacturing bill
stories.s: CEO John Ternus warned that RAM prices are "unprecedented" and the surge will push Apple’s December‑quarter costs higher, despite prior inventory buffering and product price hikes.

stories.h: Intel releases Intel 14A PDK version 0.9, targeting PDK 1.0 in Q1 2027
stories.s: The design kit, based on silicon measurements, lets customers develop designs for risk production, while Intel plans mass production of 14A in 2028 after risk production in late 2027.

stories.h: Team Group qlobal yaddaş çatışmazlığının daha da ağırlaşacağını bildirir, DDR5 16 Gb qiyməti 48 dollara çatıb
stories.s: Qazanc konfransında Team Group tələbatın 2026-cı ilin IV rübündən 2027-ci ilin II rübünə qədər pikə çatacağını bildirib. Şirkət qeyd edib ki, spot DDR5 qiymətləri 2025-ci ilin oktyabrında 8,7 dollardan 2026-cı ilin sentyabrında təxminən 48 dollara yüksəlib, üçüncü tərəflər üçün isə təchizat məhduddur.
stories.he: Team Group warns global memory shortage will worsen, DDR5 16 Gb price up to $48

stories.h: Corsair cuts $180 off the 4TB MP700 Pro SE Gen 5 SSD, now $650
stories.s: The price drop makes the drive the cheapest 4TB Gen 5 SSD at about 14.5 cents per GB, with up to 14,000 MB/s read and 12,000 MB/s write speeds and a five‑year warranty.

stories.h: KitGuru reviews Cougar DuoAir case priced at US$89.99
stories.s: The review highlights interchangeable glass or mesh front panels, five pre‑installed ARGB fans, and recommends the mesh panel for better cooling despite the case's solid build and minor drawbacks.

stories.h: Samsung və SK hynix-in HBM yaddaş çipləri Çinə qanunsuz yolla daşınır, qiymətlər vahidə 4 000 dollara yüksəlib
stories.s: Cənub Koreya çip dizayn şirkəti ixrac nəzarətini aşmaq üçün aşağı performanslı prosessorlardan istifadə edir, bu da yüksək səviyyəli HBM3E çiplərinin Honqkonq vasitəsilə Şençenə göndərilməsinə imkan verir. Brokerlər indi bu çipləri təxminən 4 000 dollardan satır, bir il əvvəl isə qiyməti bir neçə yüz dollar idi.
stories.he: HBM memory chips from Samsung and SK hynix are being smuggled into China, driving prices to $4,000 per unit

stories.h: Steam Survey shows 32GB RAM PCs drop by 5.16% and 1TB+ storage PCs fall 4.68%
stories.s: The proportion of gamers using 32GB RAM systems fell by 5.16% while those with 1TB or more storage decreased by 4.68%, indicating a shift toward lower‑spec configurations amid AI‑driven component shortages.

stories.h: Amazon closed AI creator's account after he attempted to purchase seven Nvidia DGX Spark mini-PCs
stories.s: Creator Nick Saraev said Amazon cancelled all orders and terminated his account without explanation, citing verification issues, while Epic CEO Tim Sweeney reported similar order cancellations for two GPUs.

stories.h: Asus launches ProArt PA329CDV 31.5" 4K QD-OLED monitor starting at EUR 900
stories.s: The EU price is listed from EUR 900, matching a US launch price of USD 899, and the panel offers 120 Hz, 1,000‑nit HDR peak in 3% of the screen and a three‑year burn‑in warranty.

stories.h: MSI MAG 276QR42 27-inch QHD monitor launches with up to 425Hz refresh rate
stories.s: The Rapid IPS panel retails in China for about $301 (CNY 1,998) and offers 0.5ms GtG response, 97% DCI‑P3/Adobe RGB coverage and HDMI 2.1/DP 1.4a inputs, though MSI has not set prices for other markets.

stories.h: Marvell to acquire Lumentum in an all‑stock deal valued at $115 billion
stories.s: The deal gives Lumentum shareholders 4.500 Marvell shares per Lumentum share, valuing Lumentum at $1,132 per share and giving Marvell shareholders about 67% of the combined company.

stories.h: NVIDIA RTX 50 seriyası ehtiyatları tükənir, satıcılar RTX 3060 və 3050 modellərinə yönəlir
stories.s: ChannelGate-in məlumatına görə, Çinin GPU istehsalçıları madencilik və promosyonların RTX 50 stokunu tükətməsi səbəbindən satıcıları köhnə RTX 3060 və 3050 kartlarına yönəldir, pərakəndə satıcılar isə köhnə modellərin satışını təşviq edir.
stories.he: NVIDIA RTX 50-series inventory dries up, sellers push RTX 3060 and 3050

stories.h: ASUS XG Core Radeon RX 9060 XT LP limited to 75 W with down‑clocked frequencies
stories.s: The eGPU runs at 1,010 MHz base and 1,600 MHz boost (1,030 MHz/1,620 MHz in OC), far below the desktop RX 9060 XT LP’s 1,380 MHz/3,040 MHz, to stay within a 75 W power envelope via PCIe/USB4.

stories.h: Creality K3 3D printer launches at $849 with four‑tool changer
stories.s: The K3, pre‑ordered from Oct 12 and shipping Nov 2, offers a tool‑changing system, 260 mm cube build volume, but lacks a lid and TPU kit at launch and has oversized spool holders.

stories.h: PCWorld lists top external SSDs for gaming and notes price hikes due to AI data‑center demand
stories.s: The guide recommends Samsung P9, TerraMaster D1 enclosure and PNY RP60, highlighting capacities, speeds up to 40 Gbps and rising costs, with prices like $340 MSRP for the P9 and $76 for the TerraMaster enclosure.

stories.h: Valve's October Steam Survey shows 16 GB RAM and RTX 3060 regain top spots
stories.s: The survey reports 16 GB RAM at 41.42% and RTX 3060 at 3.62%, while 32 GB RAM falls to 37.06% and RTX 5070 to 3.56%, with shifts attributed to changing respondent demographics.

stories.h: NVIDIA-nın Brev bulud platformasında 16 gün ərzində SSH açarlarının ifşa olduğu təhlükəsizlik sızması baş verib
stories.s: NVIDIA Brev xidmətində oktyabrın 4-dən 20-nə qədər icazəsiz fəaliyyət qeydə alındığını açıqlayıb, təsirlənən açarları dəyişib və istismarın aşkarlanmadığını bildirib, lakin hücum vektoru ilə bağlı detallar hələ də naməlumdur
stories.he: NVIDIA Brev cloud platform suffered a security breach exposing SSH keys over a 16‑day period

stories.h: Qualcomm HBC yığılmış yaddaşının AI250 üçün 133 TB/s zolaq eni əldə etdiyini təsdiqləyib
stories.s: Şirkət High Bandwidth Compute (HBC) arxitekturasının vatt başına 6 dəfə zolaq eni təmin etdiyini və 2027-ci ilin birinci yarısında Dragonfly AI250 sürətləndiricisində nümunələrin ötürülməsinin başlayacağını təsdiqləyib.
stories.he: Qualcomm validates HBC stacked memory achieving 133 TB/s bandwidth for AI250

stories.h: Raspberry Pi 5 16GB price raised to $385, an $80 increase
stories.s: CEO Eben Upton said the hike is due to steep memory cost rises, while the 16GB Compute Module 5 goes up $40 and the 500+ model stays unchanged.

stories.h: MSI RTX 50-series GPUs priced from $810 to $5,200 can run local AI models
stories.s: The RTX 5070 (12GB) starts at $810, the 5070 Ti (16GB) at $1,170, the RTX 5080 (16GB) at $1,650, and the RTX 5090 (32GB) at $5,200, each offering varying AI and gaming performance.

stories.h: NV UEFI Unlocker claims up to 75% AI compute boost on RTX 20‑40 cards
stories.s: The open‑source tool modifies firmware registers before driver load, showing reported TFLOPS gains of 67‑75% in synthetic tests, but real‑world AI speedups are lower and setup requires Secure Boot disabled.

stories.h: SeaSonic releases red FOCUS PX-1000 ROSSO 1000W PSU in China for US$255
stories.s: The limited‑edition unit costs CNY 1,699 and includes a matching XTIA Xproto‑Z case bundle priced at CNY 2,399 (US$361).

stories.h: MSI launches 33 kg MEG MAESTRO 900R case and MEG CORELIQUID E15 360 AIO in Japan
stories.s: The full‑tower case is priced at ¥145,800 (~US$927) and the cooler at ¥78,980 (~US$502), featuring extensive I/O, a 6.67‑inch AMOLED display and support for large components.

stories.h: GALAX launches Metal Master T8 dual‑tower CPU cooler priced around $34
stories.s: The cooler supports Intel LGA1851, AMD AM5 and older sockets, measures 125 × 137 × 159 mm, and features two 120 mm fans with up to 84.57 CFM airflow, but performance data are not independently verified.

stories.h: Akihabara DDR5-5600 128GB kitlərinin dəyəri əvvəlki minimumlardan kəskin artaraq təxminən $2,540–$2,790 səviyyəsinə çatdı
stories.s: Guru3D-nin məlumatına görə, sorğuda 128GB DDR5-5600 kitlərinin qiyməti təxminən $2,540 səviyyəsində, bəzi təkliflərdə isə $2,790 səviyyəsində qeydə alınıb. 64GB kitlərinin mövcudluğu iki dəfə azalarkən, qiymətlər illik əsasda 62,4%-ə qədər artıb.
stories.he: Akihabara DDR5-5600 128GB kits hit about $2,540–$2,790, up sharply from earlier lows

stories.h: Alphacool launches Apex 1 AM5 White CPU water block with €189.98 MSRP
stories.s: The new white edition features a nickel-plated copper block, cross-slot technology and AM5 hotspot optimization for AMD platforms, targeting enthusiasts seeking a stylish cooling solution.

stories.h: NVIDIA and ASRock Rack unveil liquid‑cooled Vera Rubin NVL72 rack with 36 CPUs and 72 GPUs
stories.s: The 48RU system delivers 3,600 PFLOPS sparse and 2,520 PFLOPS dense inference, 20.7TB HBM4 memory and 110kW per power shelf, showcased at OCP Global Summit 2026.

stories.h: Modded RTX 2080 Ti 22 GB outperforms standard 11 GB model in 4K tests
stories.s: The upgraded card averaged 52.5 FPS in Flight Simulator 2024 versus 30.2 FPS on the stock version, and showed similar gains in Spider‑Man 2, though it costs about €500 on the secondary market.

stories.h: Developer releases open-source UEFI driver to enable Resizable BAR on Intel Haswell 8-series motherboards
stories.s: The reBART driver adds BAR support for Z87, H87, Q87, B85, Q85 and H81 boards, allowing GPUs like Arc A750 to use unlimited BAR sizes, though it requires BIOS flashing and a DSDT patch.

stories.h: Tom's Hardware reviews Biwin M560 2TB PCIe 5.0 DRAM-less SSD at $364.99
stories.s: The review highlights 11,000 MB/s read, 10,000 MB/s write speeds and up to 1.7 M IOPS, noting its five‑year warranty and 1,500 TBW endurance.

stories.h: Open-source UEFI tool unlocks Nvidia GPU tensor limiter on Windows
stories.s: The nv-uefi-unlocker runs from a FAT32 USB stick before driver load, boosting FP16 performance up to 65% on supported RTX 20‑40 cards without flashing BIOS, but must be used each boot and Secure Boot must be disabled.

stories.h: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman meets Samsung leadership to discuss AI memory needs
stories.s: The talks in Yongin covered AI strategy but did not announce a new DRAM supply deal, despite a 2025 letter of intent for the Stargate project and ongoing memory shortages.

stories.h: AES-256 şifrəli kimi satılan Lenovo ThinkPlus FU100 USB yaddaş əslində şifrələnməmiş SD kartdır
stories.s: Tədqiqatçı Xusheng Li barmaq izi oxuyucusunun yalnız USB bağlantısını aktivləşdirdiyini, məlumatları isə qorunmasız vəziyyətdə saxladığını nümayiş etdirib. Lenovo xəbərdarlığın ciddiyyətini yüksək səviyyədə qiymətləndirib; kimliyin təsdiqlənməsinin aşılması ilə bağlı CVE-lər qeydə alınıb.
stories.he: Lenovo ThinkPlus FU100 USB stick marketed as AES‑256 encrypted is actually an unencrypted SD card

stories.h: NVIDIA Vera Rubin GPU spesifikasiyalarını yeniləyib, yaddaş və NVLink zolaq enini aşağı salıb
stories.s: NVIDIA-nin yenilənmiş datasheetinə görə, təchizat spesifikasiyaları indi 19.2TB/s GPU yaddaş zolaq enini (əvvəlki 22TB/s-dən aşağı) və 3.0TB/s NVLink zolaq enini (əvvəlki 3.6TB/s-dən aşağı) göstərir, scale-out şəbəkə isə 0.45TB/s-ə yüksəlir.
stories.he: NVIDIA revises Vera Rubin GPU specs, lowering memory and NVLink bandwidth

stories.h: Tuxedo launches Nano Pro Gen15 mini PC with Intel Core Ultra X7 358H and Linux
stories.s: The €1,749 base model includes 16 GB DDR5‑7200 RAM, 500 GB WD Blue SN5100 SSD and Wi‑Fi 7, and optional upgrades up to 128 GB RAM increase price accordingly.

stories.h: ASRock Radeon RX 7000 seriyası üçün AMD təhlükəsizlik zəifliyini aradan qaldıran vBIOS 1.0.5 versiyasını yayımlayıb
stories.s: 29 oktyabr tarixində yayımlanan yeniləmə on RX 7000 modelini əhatə edir və Sapphire və GIGABYTE-in oxşar düzəlişlərindən sonra gəlir; AMD potensial zəiflikləri aradan qaldırdığını, lakin heç bir məlum eksploit aşkar edilmədiyini bildirir.
stories.he: ASRock releases vBIOS 1.0.5 for Radeon RX 7000 series addressing AMD security vulnerability

stories.h: Acer lists Predator Atlas 8 handheld with Intel Arc G3 Extreme for $1,299.99
stories.s: The base model with 24 GB RAM and 512 GB SSD is now available at Best Buy, while higher‑spec variants cost up to £1,499.99 ($2,019).

stories.h: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says home PCs waste limited DRAM supply
stories.s: Altman argued on the Cheeky Pint podcast that personal computers use DRAM only 5% of the time and that the scarce memory should stay in data centers for better utilization.

stories.h: ASRock B860 Challenger Wifi motherboard launches at $149.99
stories.s: Tom's Hardware tests show it runs Intel Core Ultra 270K Plus well despite limited USB speed, modest power delivery and an older BIOS, offering solid performance for its price.

stories.h: Intel reallocates client CPU capacity to Xeon server chips amid AI demand
stories.s: Intel will shift 18A production from Panther Lake PCs to Intel 3 for Granite Rapids Xeons and expand Fab 24 in Ireland, Fab 62 in Arizona, and advanced packaging in New Mexico and Malaysia, with added capacity expected in H2 2027.

stories.h: TrashBench cools an RTX 3080 to 28°C using a repurposed 4‑kW AC radiator
stories.s: The YouTube creator modified a split‑system air‑conditioner radiator into a water‑cooling loop, dropping the RTX 3080's temperature from 65°C to 28°C and the i9‑14900K CPU by 18°C, but overclocking only raised FPS by about 3%.

stories.h: Intel Q3 2026 revenue hits $16.5 billion, data‑center sales jump 78% while PC segment falls 5%
stories.s: Intel CFO David Zinsner called the data‑center growth the strongest in 15 years, but client PC revenue slipped due to memory price pressure, which the company expects to continue into 2027.

stories.h: Nvidia RTX 5080-i ABŞ mağazasından çıxardı, qiymətlər MSRP-dən 2.2 dəfədən çoxa yüksəldi
stories.s: GeForce RTX 5080 elanları RTX 5090-un çıxarılmasından iki həftə sonra Nvidianın ABŞ bazar yerindən yox oldu. Hazırda ən ucuz mövcud nümunənin qiyməti $2,199.99-dir ki, bu da $999 olan satışa çıxarılma qiymətindən təxminən 2.2 dəfə çoxdur.
stories.he: Nvidia removes RTX 5080 from US store as prices soar to over 2.2 × MSRP

stories.h: UPERFECT GR14BU 14-inch OLED portable monitor launches at $399.99
stories.s: The touch-enabled GR14BU features a 2880×1800 panel, 120 Hz USB‑C video, aluminium chassis 7 mm thick, and weighs 0.59 kg, down from its previous $629.99 list price.

stories.h: BrainChip launches AKD1500 Raspberry Pi 5 Development Kit
stories.s: The kit pairs a Raspberry Pi 5 with BrainChip's AKD1500 M.2 board for low-power always‑on AI, and is available now via the BrainChip Shop.

stories.h: Gigabyte launches WRX90 AI TOP workstation motherboard with support for Threadripper PRO and up to 2 TB DDR5 ECC memory
stories.s: The board offers seven PCIe 5.0 x16 slots, nine‑GPU expansion capability, dual 10 GbE LAN, and integrated BMC for remote management, targeting local AI development platforms.

stories.h: AMD releases Adrenalin 26.10.2 driver with multiple bug fixes for Radeon GPUs and Ryzen AI processors
stories.s: The update addresses crashes and timeouts with overlays, Steam launcher, video playback, and several games, and adds known issues for RX 7000/9000 series and Ryzen AI 400-series CPUs.

stories.h: Attack Shark launches X60 gaming headset with RGB wireless‑charging dock
stories.s: The X60 features a 53 mm driver, AI‑enhanced mic, 2.4 GHz low‑latency wireless and a dock that adds USB/Type‑C ports, with availability from 4 Nov 2026.

stories.h: Epomaker launches EM3 carbon-fiber gaming mouse priced at $35.99
stories.s: The EM3 weighs about 56 g, features a PAW3315 sensor with up to 16000 DPI, 1000 Hz polling, and tri‑mode wired, 2.4 GHz wireless and Bluetooth connectivity, and ships via Epomaker’s website, Amazon and AliExpress.

stories.h: Ocypus Iota P1000 1000W PSU reviewed with 80 Plus Gold and ATX 3.1 compliance
stories.s: TechPowerUp tested the fully modular unit, noting its 120 mm FDB fan, zero‑RPM ECO mode and native PCIe 5.1 support via a 12V‑2x6 connector.

stories.h: Linux 7.4 kernel merges AMD Ryzen Zen 6 driver updates
stories.s: The updates, added this week, improve support for Zen 6 CPUs and enhance laptop power management, ahead of the kernel merge window closing this weekend.

stories.h: TCL 27C2A Pro 27-inch QD‑Mini LED monitor reviewed at $600 with 2,000‑nit HDR peak
stories.s: Tom's Hardware finds the monitor extremely bright with 2,000 nits HDR in a 3% window, 160 Hz 4K/320 Hz FHD refresh rates, and strong color accuracy, but notes a wobbly stand.

stories.h: Samsung launches P9 USB4 external SSD with up to 8TB capacity
stories.s: The P9 offers 40Gbps speeds, a five‑year warranty and stays cool under load, but prices range from $340 for 1TB to $2,880 for 8TB and it is currently out of stock on Samsung’s site.

stories.h: Asus ProArt P16 RTX Spark laptop outperforms a desktop with RTX 5090 in AI workload
stories.s: The laptop’s 128 GB unified LPDDR5X memory gave the GPU about 96 GB, letting it finish a 120‑billion‑parameter model 19 minutes faster than a desktop with a RTX 5090 and 96 GB system RAM.

stories.h: MSI Prestige N16 Flip AI+ C1XM launches with NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X and up to 128 GB unified memory
stories.s: The convertible 16‑inch laptop pairs an NVIDIA Grace‑based Arm CPU with a Blackwell GPU, targeting AI‑assisted creative work and local model inference, and offers OLED display options and Wi‑Fi 7 connectivity.

stories.h: MSI cuts prices of several gaming monitors, QD-OLED models up to £220 off
stories.s: The MAG 272QP QD-OLED drops from £699 to £479 and other models see reductions of £120‑£200, with deals running through November.

stories.h: Nvidia 88 nüvəli Vera data-mərkəz CPU-sunu təqdim etdi – 1.5 TB-ya qədər yaddaş və 1.2 TB/s zolaq genişliyi
stories.s: Armv9.2-A arxitekturası əsasında hazırlanan, 88 nüvə, 176 iş parçacığı, 250-450 V TDP və 9600 MT/s-ə qədər LPDDR5X xüsusiyyətlərinə malik Vera prosessoru Tom's Hardware benchmark testlərində müqayisə olunan AMD və Intel çiplərindən üstün nəticə göstərir.
stories.he: Nvidia unveils Vera 88-core data‑center CPU with up to 1.5 TB memory and 1.2 TB/s bandwidth

stories.h: Intel Fab 28-də partlayış iki həftəlik dayanmaya səbəb oldu – 600 milyon dollarlıq ziyan, 10nm Xeon çatdırılmaları dayandırıldı
stories.s: Partlayışda iki işçi həyatını itirib, biri yaralanıb. Hadisə Intel-in 2026-cı ilin IV rübdəki gəlirlərini təxminən 300 milyon dollar, 2027-ci ilin I rübündə isə eyni miqdarda azalacaq və server prosessoru istehsalında altı aylıq pozğunluğa səbəb olacaq.
stories.he: Intel Fab 28 explosion forces two‑week shutdown, costing $600 million and halting 10nm Xeon shipments

stories.h: ATK launches RS8 Air HE keyboard for $99.98 (discounted to $74.89) and RS8 Neo mechanical keyboard starting at $84.98
stories.s: Both TKL keyboards feature aluminium CNC cases, RGB lighting and 8 kHz polling; the Air uses Hall effect switches while the Neo adds Bluetooth and a 12,000 mAh battery.

stories.h: DDR5 memory prices in Japan surge 760.9% YoY, 128GB kit now ¥514,800 ($2,872)
stories.s: Akiba PC’s survey for Oct 17‑24 shows the 128GB DDR5‑6000 kit up ¥197,820 (62.4%) from last month and 760.9% higher than early Oct 2025, while 32GB kits also hit record highs.

stories.h: CXMT plans to sell HBM3E memory despite 20‑30% yield
stories.s: The Chinese maker will allocate about 20% of its 300,000‑wafer monthly DRAM capacity to HBM3E, targeting mass production in 2027, despite low yields that could raise costs.

stories.h: GitHub adds 4 million CPU cores, 160 PB storage to handle AI‑generated code surge
stories.s: The platform reports a sixfold rise to 7.4 billion monthly commits, prompting a 50 Tb/s network upgrade and re‑engineered backend to decouple storage from compute.

stories.h: Intel Nova Lake masaüstü prosessorlarının 18A-P texnologiyasından istifadə edəcəyini təsdiqləyib
stories.s: CEO Lip-Bu Tan 2026-cı ilin III rübü üzrə maliyyə nəticələrinin açıqlanması zamanı bəyan edib ki, Nova Lake gücləndirilmiş 18A-P texnologiyasında istehsal olunan ilk müştəri məhsulu olacaq. Buraxılış zamanı dizayn qazancalarının Panther Lake-in iki qatına çatması gözlənilir, daha ətraflı məlumatlar isə CES-də paylaşılacaq.
stories.he: Intel confirms Nova Lake desktop CPUs will use 18A-P node

stories.h: PCB shortages could push motherboard and GPU prices up 12‑fold by 2030
stories.s: An unnamed executive from an American PC maker told Nikkei Asia that PCB lead times may reach 30 months and copper‑clad laminate costs have risen 12 times since July, risking price hikes across the PC ecosystem.

stories.h: Solidigm is weighing a $45 billion investment to build NAND flash capacity in the United States
stories.s: The SK hynix‑owned maker plans the expansion after seeking U.S. approval to ship equipment to its Dalian, China fabs, aiming to boost wafer output from 100,000 to about 150,000 per month by 2027 and start 3D QLC production for enterprise SSDs

stories.h: ASRock Industrial launches AI Box-A395 mini‑PC with AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 and 128 GB LPDDR5X
stories.s: The barebones system features a 16‑core/32‑thread 5.1 GHz processor, Radeon 8060S graphics, 400 W internal PSU and Wi‑Fi 7, targeting industrial AI workloads.

stories.h: Microsoft adds DirectX Dump Files for GPU crash diagnostics on Windows PCs
stories.s: The new feature, included in Agility SDK 1.620 and PIX 2610.28, lets developers capture up to 2 MB of crash data and supports AMD Radeon RX 7000/9000, NVIDIA RTX 20 series and newer, with Intel support pending.

stories.h: Razer launches Reclusa Mini 65% wireless keyboard with Hall Effect magnetic switches
stories.s: The 65% board offers adjustable actuation from 0.1mm to 4.0mm, hot‑swappable magnetic switches, tri‑mode connectivity and per‑key Chroma RGB, priced at £129.99/$129.99/€149.99.

stories.h: Thermalright launches Levita Vision V2 AIO cooler and three new Assassin Classic air coolers
stories.s: The V2 features a 6.67-inch 2400×1080 AMOLED display, 2400 rpm fans with 74.4 CFM airflow, and supports AM4, AM5, LGA115x, LGA1200, LGA1700, LGA1851 sockets; the air models add ARGB and varied heatpipe counts.

stories.h: Cooler Master launches Gold edition MasterFrame 400 Mesh case and MasterLiquid Atmos II Pro Gold AIO cooler
stories.s: The MasterFrame 400 Mesh Gold supports Micro ATX and Mini ITX boards, GPUs up to three hundred and ninety millimetres, and ships mid‑November via META PCs; the MasterLiquid Atmos II Pro Gold retails for $199.99 and supports LGA 1851, LGA 1700, AM5 and AM4 platforms.

stories.h: AI demand drives PCB lead times to 30 months and costs up 12‑fold
stories.s: Nikkei cites unnamed execs from an American PC maker and Taiwanese PCB suppliers saying orders won’t be fulfilled until late 2028, with CCL costs up 12 times since July and order books full to 2030.

stories.h: HAVN launches HS 360 and HS 360 VGPU mid‑tower cases globally
stories.s: The HS 360 is priced at $199.99 (£169.99) and the VGPU version at $279.99 (£239.99), featuring a dual‑chamber layout, back‑connect ATX support and up to 6 °C lower GPU temps via a magnetic airflow divider.

stories.h: MSI launches PRO MAX EDGE AI+ workstation with Ryzen AI Max+ 395 and 128GB unified memory
stories.s: The compact 4‑litre desktop, priced at ¥818,000 (~US$5,181), ships with a 2TB NVMe SSD, Wi‑Fi 7, USB4 and integrated Radeon 8060S, targeting local LLMs up to 120 billion parameters.

stories.h: ASUS adds ROG Equalizer cable to five 1,000W and 1,200W power supplies
stories.s: The new cable, rated for up to 17A, balances current in a 12V-2x6 connection and includes a visual status indicator; Japanese prices range from US$298 to US$563 and sales start Oct 30.

stories.h: HAVN releases HS 360 VGPU case, 19.4% smaller and 29.5% lighter than HS 420
stories.s: The new full‑tower case supports rear‑connect ATX motherboards, omits 140 mm fans and weighs 13.4 kg, with optional 120 mm fan mounts and a 360 mm radiator layout.

stories.h: HP HyperX Omen 35L gaming PC reviewed at $6,210.98 with Ryzen 9 9950X3D and RTX 5080
stories.s: Tom's Hardware tested the system’s 4K performance, noting up to 120 fps in 007 First Light and mixed results against RTX 5090 rivals, while criticizing its steep price and lack of USB4/Thunderbolt 4.

stories.h: Netgear bir neçə modeli əhatə edən üç router və genişləndirici təhlükəsizlik zəifliyinə yamaq yayımlayıb
stories.s: Yamaqlar CVE-2026-11732, CVE-2026-11731 və CVE-2026-11730 zəifliklərini aradan qaldırır. Bu zəifliklər hakerlərin əmrlər icra etməsinə və ya idarəetmə sessiyalarını ələ keçirməsinə imkan verə bilərdi. İstifadəçilərə dərhal firmware quraşdırmağa çağırış olunur.
stories.he: Netgear patches three router and extender security flaws affecting multiple models

stories.h: NVIDIA Vera CPU performance compared in single vs dual socket setups
stories.s: Phoronix benchmark shows scaling results for one and two Vera CPUs, detailing power and performance differences.

stories.h: Corsair partners with Embark Studios for limited‑edition ARC Raiders gaming gear
stories.s: The collection, announced on October 29, includes SCUF controllers, Corsair keyboards, mice, headset and Elgato Stream Decks, all featuring the game’s four‑stripe design and in‑game item codes.

stories.h: Synology DS918+ NAS compromised by ransomware exploiting CVE‑2024‑10441
stories.s: Reddit user NakamuraHwang’s internet‑exposed DS918+ was about 18 months out‑of‑date, allowing attackers to abuse the remote code execution vulnerability; Synology’s UI can falsely report the device as up to date.

stories.h: AMD releases ROCm HRX Loom v0.1 SDK for its CPUs, GPUs and NPUs
stories.s: The Loom SDK v0.1 was announced at the AMD Advancing AI event, targeting agentic workload optimizations on AMD hardware.

stories.h: AMD releases FSR SDK 2.4 with Vulkan support and ML upscaling for Radeon RX 6000‑9000 series
stories.s: The SDK adds FSR Upscaling 4.1.2, Frame Generation 4.0.2 and driver‑assisted pacing for RX 9000 GPUs, requiring Adrenalin 26.10.1+ and Vulkan 1.2, but does not provide a universal driver upgrade.

stories.h: SK hynix forecasts memory demand to outpace supply through 2030
stories.s: The Korean chipmaker said server DDR5 and HBM4 growth will keep demand ahead of supply, citing AI, autonomous driving and robotics as drivers, and noted long lead times for new fabs.

stories.h: Apple adds 512GB memory Mac Studio with M5 Ultra, starting at $24,618
stories.s: The new Mac Studio uses the M5 Ultra with 36 CPU cores and 80 GPU cores, offers a 1TB SSD and ships in 10‑12 weeks, with a 16TB SSD option priced at $32,701.

stories.h: GPD confirms upcoming Win Mini Ultra handheld powered by Intel Arc G3 Extreme
stories.s: The device will feature a 9.8-inch 120 Hz IPS display, up to 32 GB LPDDR5x RAM, a 54 Wh battery with 100 W USB‑PD charging, and a replaceable M.2 2280 PCIe 5.0 ×4 SSD, according to GPD's Weibo post.

stories.h: System76 launches Thelio Prime 11‑liter Linux desktop starting at $1,599
stories.s: The compact desktop offers up to an AMD Ryzen 7 9850X3D CPU, optional RTX 5070 GPU, up to 96 GB DDR5 RAM, 8 TB storage and a 600 W PSU, with shipments beginning November 18.

stories.h: Apple's new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR touchscreen starts at $14,549
stories.s: The 16‑inch model adds a 16TB SSD for $7,000, while the 14‑inch starts at $2,899, marking Apple's first laptop touchscreen and a premium price that rivals high‑end Windows laptops.

stories.h: Phantom Blade Zero launches with DLSS 4.5, ray tracing and path tracing on GeForce RTX and RTX Spark
stories.s: The game released today at 7 pm PT on Steam and Epic, featuring DLSS 4.5 technologies, Dynamic Multi Frame Generation and up to 9× frame‑rate boost on RTX 5090 GPUs.

stories.h: System76 announces Thelio Prime AMD-powered Linux mini PC to ship in November
stories.s: The new Thelio Prime desktop, featuring AMD CPUs, was teased by System76 and is slated for November release, targeting Linux enthusiasts and small‑form‑factor builds.

stories.h: Formula V Line launches Crystal Z3 Plus mid‑tower case priced at US$79.99–$89.99
stories.s: The new panoramic case features a removable bottom‑fan bracket, tool‑free panels and a 90° rotatable rear PCIe bracket for vertical GPU mounting, supporting ATX, Micro‑ATX and Mini‑ITX builds.

stories.h: CXMT 2026-cı ilin sonuna qədər HBM3E yaddaşının kütləvi istehsalına başlayacaq
stories.s: Reuters-in məlumatına görə, CXMT iki ay ərzində HBM3E istehsalına başlayacaq. Hədəf 1.2 TB/s zolaq eni və 36 GB-ə qədər tutumdur, lakin hazırda verim təxminən 20% səviyyəsindədir.
stories.he: CXMT to start mass production of HBM3E memory by end of 2026

stories.h: Thermal Grizzly releases DeltaMate MPII CPU block for Intel LGA 1851
stories.s: TechPowerUp reviews the flagship DeltaMate MPII, noting its ultra‑high performance and pre‑release sample status after a chat at Computex.

stories.h: Yaddaş qiymətləri 12 ayda 500% artaraq HP, Asus və Acer-i bəzi PC istehsalını Çinə geri daşımaya təkan verib
stories.s: Nikkei Asia qeyd edir ki, süni intellektə bağlı komponent qiymətlərinin artması üç istehsalçıya Luxshare, Huaqin və Longcheer kimi kiçik Çin sifariş əsaslı istehsalçıları ilə müqavilə imzalamaya məcbur edib. Bu, qiymət təzyiqini azaltsa da, Cənub-Şərq Asiyadakı yeni istehsal xətlərinə təsir edib.
stories.he: Memory prices surge 500% in 12 months, prompting HP, Asus and Acer to shift some PC manufacturing back to China

stories.h: Phoronix publishes first CachyOS vs Fedora 45 vs Ubuntu 26.10 benchmarks on AMD Ryzen 9 9900X3D2
stories.s: The benchmarks compare the performance‑optimized Arch‑based CachyOS with the newly released Ubuntu 26.10 and near‑release Fedora Workstation 45 on an AMD Ryzen 9 9900X3D2 desktop system.

stories.h: Corsair releases the Warthog mid‑tower case priced at $179.99
stories.s: The military‑styled chassis offers high airflow, built‑in GPU support and optional fans, but its higher cost and average GPU cooling keep it from topping the best‑case list, according to Tom's Hardware.

stories.h: Seagate 16TB external HDD drops to $399.99 on Newegg
stories.s: The price is $150 lower than the $549.99 list price and $50 cheaper than its recent Prime Day price, offering a 0.025 cents per GB rate.

stories.h: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080-in ABŞ-da satış qiyməti demək olar ki, 2 000 dollara yüksəlib
stories.s: İlkin olaraq 999 dollar MSRP ilə təqdim olunan yüksək səviyyəli qrafik prosessor (GPU) hazırda Best Buy, Micro Center, Amazon, Newegg və B&H kimi pərakəndə satıcılarda 2 000 dollar və ya daha çoxa satılır. Qiymət artımı GDDR7 yaddaş təchizatının məhdud olması və tərəfdaşların əlavə etdiyi xüsusiyyətlərlə əlaqədardır.
stories.he: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 listings in the U.S. have risen to nearly $2,000

stories.h: Nvidia Vera CPUs become generally available on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Superclusters
stories.s: Nvidia and Oracle announced GA of the Vera Rubin NVL72 rack and standalone Vera CPUs on OCI Superclusters, highlighting up to 1.2 TB/s memory bandwidth that doubles dual Xeon 6980P performance in benchmarks.

stories.h: Core 4 Solutions lists a 300‑rack AI supercomputer with 9,600 Nvidia A100 GPUs for $59.7 million on eBay
stories.s: The cluster includes 4,200 AMD EPYC Rome 64‑core CPUs, 1.4 PB of DDR4 memory and ships with optional $50 overnight delivery, according to Tom's Hardware.

stories.h: ASUS launches 720Hz ROG Swift OLED PG259QWS Ace and 540Hz ROG Strix OLED XG259QWPG Ace esports monitors
stories.s: The 24.5‑inch OLED monitors feature 0.02 ms response, up to 1700 nits brightness and OLED‑specific features, with the PG259QWS Ace priced around $1,099 and serving as the official display for PGL CS2 Major Singapore 2026.

stories.h: KLEVV launches CRAS V RGB PRIME DDR5 memory with speeds up to 8000 MT/s and CL26 latency
stories.s: The new kits range from 32 GB to 128 GB, support AMD EXPO Ultra Low Latency and Intel XMP, and are compatible with AMD AM5 and Intel Core Ultra 200S Plus platforms.

stories.h: Alienware launches 31.5-inch AW3226Q 4K OLED monitor in the US for $699.99
stories.s: The AW3226Q features a tandem RGB‑stripe OLED panel, 165 Hz refresh, HDR True Black 400, Dolby Vision, HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort, and comes with a three‑year burn‑in warranty.

stories.h: NVIDIA releases GeForce Hotfix 621.12 to fix RTX 50 video freezes and UE5.8 crash
